query: How much should I keep in my emergency fund? I have a stable government job and no dependents.
plausible_answers: Answer A (3 Months Default): Keep 3 months of essential expenses — your stable government job and lack of dependents puts you at the low end of the standard range, and cash beyond that is better invested.
Answer B (6 Months for Security): Maintain 6 months regardless of job stability, because emergencies extend well beyond job loss — medical events and major repairs can rapidly deplete a smaller fund.

Answer C (1–2 Months Plus Credit): With strong government employment protections and available credit lines, 1–2 months of liquid savings is sufficient — redirect the rest aggressively into tax-advantaged investment accounts.
baseline_answer: Answer A (3 Months Default): Keep 3 months of essential expenses — your stable government job and lack of dependents puts you at the low end of the standard range, and cash beyond that is better invested.
